description:
Resolves a ticker, name, prefix or `0x` address to candidate ERC-20 tokens on Arc.

- **Cost:** 0.005 USDC per call, paid over x402.
- **Inputs:** `query` (required), `limit` (1-25, default 10), and the optional filters `launchpad` and `launchpadKind`. A filter narrows `results` only: `resolution`, ranks and flags are the unfiltered search's.
- **Returns:** the matches, most relevant first. Each has its verification status, safety verdicts, USDC and hub pools, `launch`, where the token was launched, and `exitRisk`, the token's stored exit-risk rating (did outside buyers get out?), null when it has none yet. `exitRisk` is separate from the sell-check verdict in `safety`. Its shares are in basis points, and its `limitations` say what it cannot see. Check verification and safety before you trade. A `lookalike` match resembles another token's ticker or name and may be an impostor.
- **Errors:**
  - 404 `token_not_found`: no ERC-20 token at that address.
  - 429 `lookup_rate_limited`: too many failed address lookups. Wait `retryAfterSec`.
  - 503 `rpc_unavailable`: the chain could not be reached. Retry shortly.
- **Next:**
  - `tradeQuote`: price a swap with the chosen result's `address` as `sell` or `buy`.

Costs 5000 base units (0.005 USDC) per call. Or send an account's key in the ARCGATE-KEY header on the MCP connection to pay in units instead. Payment goes in params._meta["x402/payment"]; use an x402-aware MCP client (see https://docs.arcgate.dev/#arcgate/description/mcp-for-agents).

launchpad.description: Only tokens whose launch.launchpad (launchpadKind: launch.kind) is one of these. A token not attributed yet (null) matches none. The filters narrow `results` only: `resolution`, ranks and flags are decided over every token the query matched.

launchpadKind.description: Only tokens whose launch.kind is one of these. A token not attributed yet (null) matches none. The filters narrow `results` only: `resolution`, ranks and flags are decided over every token the query matched.

name: tradeSearch
